faq_items.answer: Recent advancements in AI have simplified self-hosting by making it easier to set up and manage AI models locally, enhancing privacy and control over data.

faq_items.question: What role does Google play in AI agent development?
faq_items.answer: Google mandates that AI agents use its MCP servers, but issues arose when the Gmail app tried to send emails, highlighting the complexities in integrating AI with existing services.
